newsitem.title: USA: Dow extends burst amid flurry of buy programs.
newsitem.headline: Dow extends burst amid flurry of buy programs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks powered to session highs with the Dow industrials surging more than 100 points in late afternoon on Monday.
The Dow stood at 7182, up 110 points for the day. If the Dow were to hold those gains, the session would rank as the eighth largest point gain in the history of the blue chip average.
Traders said a wave of buy programs were contributing to the Dow's advance, which picked up steam about midday through the afternoon portion of the session.
"We have been in definite buy program territory since about 2:30," said Mike Rothberg, manager of portfolio and program trading at Cantor Fitzgerald.

Analysts said the buying appeared to coincide with something of a sellers' strike in the wake of the budget agreement and anticipation that a capital gains tax cut would take effect sometime this year.
A bounce in tobacco stocks also lent late support.

RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp and Philip Morris Cos Inc reversed early losses just before trading halts in both shares for dissemination of news that a Florida jury had returned a verdict favorable to RJR Nabisco in a tobacco liability case.
